description.value: Beginning at 5th level, a necromancer radiates a 10-foot-radius fear aura as a free action. Enemies in the area must succeed on a Will save (DC 10 + half of his necromancer's level + his Charisma modifier) or become shaken for a number of rounds equal to the necromancer's Charisma modifier. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected by that necromancer's fear aura for 24 hours. Starting at 15th level, the fear aura's radius increases to 20 feet.
